contradicting_evidence: The 83% advance ratio, positive bucket medians and ETH's current outperformance could develop into a more persistent advance than a mixed forecast allows.
Conversely, negative settled ETF flows and the 7d stablecoin supply contraction could accompany renewed weakness if current demand fails; uninterrupted downside is not currently established.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Further advance attempts and retracements are both credible over the next three days. Current participation supports resilience, but sustained ETH-relative strength and renewed capital demand are needed before treating the rebound as durable continuation. A clean one-way move is not the base expectation.
falsification_conditions: Persistent BTC and ETH advances, strengthening ETH/BTC and repeated broad participation, accompanied by improving settled demand, would shift the assessment toward UP.
A sustained failure to retain gains, renewed ETH/BTC weakness and shrinking participation with continued outflows would shift the assessment toward DOWN.
missing_evidence: Repeated breadth and capitalization-proxy observations showing whether today's participation survives retracements.
Subsequent settled flow sessions and a multi-day ETH/BTC sequence that can establish improvement or renewed deterioration.
supporting_evidence: Positive hourly spot flow, rising BTC and ETH, and broad current alt participation support further recovery attempts rather than assuming uninterrupted decline.
The latest supplied settled ETF outflows and absent stablecoin deployment confirmation limit evidence for sustained demand beyond the immediate rebound.

Only about 31% of the 30d altseason constituents outperformed BTC, despite stronger current 24h participation. Short-term breadth has improved without resolving the weaker medium-window relative picture.
Price-up/open-interest-up conditions support participation but leave a leveraged retracement channel if spot buying fades.
